bioconda.name: tangram-sc
bioconda.summary: Spatial alignment of single cell transcriptomic data.
bioconda.description:
Tangram is a deep learning algorithm for mapping single-cell (or single-nucleus) gene expression data onto spatial gene expression data.
The single-cell dataset and the spatial dataset should be collected from the same anatomical region/tissue type, ideally from a biological replicate, and need to share a set of genes.
